correctness.rationale: On open L_n each simple cycle is the boundary of k consecutive squares, length 2(k+1). Exact signed CCA face charges c_i in {-1,0,1} have winding 3 sum c_i. The 2018 Gravner–Lyu–Sivakoff Theorem 3 (full PDF page 3328 inspected) gives mean activity as max signed cycle integral/length; the CCA-GHM edge-form difference is a coboundary after factoring 3. Thus CCA=3 GHM, with activity 1 iff adjacent equal nonzero face charges, 3/4 iff at least one nonzero charge but no adjacent equal nonzero charges, else0. A 3-state transfer and 9-state forbidden-adjacency transfer give Z_n and Q_n rational GF respectively 3(3-2z)/(1-7z+4z^2), 3(3+z^2)/(1-9z+z^2-3z^3). Direct independently written brute-force face-charge enumeration of every initial coloring for n=2..5 reproduced (57,24,0),(363,360,6),(2313,4140,108),(14739,42858,1452). All-n uses matrix identities and cycle structure, not extrapolation.
